# SmartyMove

> SmartyMove is a camera-based movement screening and corrective exercise app. It turns a smartphone camera into a 5-minute functional movement test, produces a Movement Score (0–100) and a Movement Age, identifies the root cause of any failed test, and prescribes a short daily corrective program. Built by the Smarty team as a pocket movement coach for people who want to move better, prevent injury, and reduce pain — without booking a clinic visit.

## What SmartyMove is

SmartyMove is a mobile-first movement screening app and corrective exercise coach. Users perform a short series of guided movement tests (squat, hinge, single-leg balance, lunge, overhead reach, plus ankle, hip, shoulder, core and scapular sub-tests) in front of their phone camera. On-device pose detection scores each rep, flags compensations (heel rise, spine rounding, knee valgus, left/right asymmetry), and clusters failures into root causes (Ankle, Hip, Core, Scapular). The app then prescribes a personalized 14-day corrective training program in three phases — Foundation, Build, Maintain & Perform — built from a curated library of mobility, stability and strength exercises. The program rescans every 14 days and progresses automatically.

## Who it's for

- Desk workers with stiff hips, low back, or shoulders
- Runners and lifters who want to keep their joints healthy
- People recovering from minor knee, hip, ankle, low back, or shoulder issues who are cleared for general exercise
- Anyone who wants an objective baseline of how they move and a short daily routine that actually targets their weakest link

SmartyMove is a wellness and education tool. It is not a medical device, not a diagnosis, and not a replacement for a physiotherapist or physician.

## How the movement screen works

1. The user completes a PAR-Q-style readiness questionnaire and picks a goal.
2. They prop up their phone and follow on-screen prompts for a short sequence of functional movement tests.
3. On-device pose detection (no raw video uploaded) measures joint angles, range of motion, tempo, and compensations on each rep, comparing them to reference values for that movement.
4. The Corrective Decision Engine clusters failures into at most two primary root causes (Ankle, Hip, Core, Scapular) so the program stays focused.
5. The app outputs a Movement Score (0–100), a Movement Age (a motivational age estimate based on movement quality vs. chronological age), and a 14-day training plan.

## Core differentiators

- **Movement Score** — a single 0–100 score summarizing movement quality across all tests, so progress is measurable.
- **Movement Age** — translates movement quality into an intuitive age number users can lower over time.
- **Root-cause clustering** — instead of prescribing 10 random exercises, the engine identifies the 1–2 deficits that explain the most failures and trains those first.
- **Compensation detection** — verifies that observed range of motion is real, not faked by heel lift, spine rounding, or shoulder shrugging.
- **Curated exercise library** — exercises come from a vetted set across 7 areas (Ankle, Knee, Hip, Low Back, Shoulder, Elbow, Wrist) × 3 categories (Mobility, Stability, Strength); nothing is invented or cross-prescribed.
- **On-device pose detection** — camera frames are processed locally; raw video is not uploaded.
- **14-day rescan cycle** — the program automatically progresses through Foundation → Build → Maintain & Perform phases as the user retests.
